headline: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas Signals Less Aggressive Hikes Amid Economic Slowdown
summary: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas Governor stated that while the central bank will tighten monetary policy as necessary to contain inflation, economic weakness has taken aggressive interest rate hikes off the table.
why: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) is the central monetary authority of the Philippines.

impacts.name: Philippines
impacts.why: BSP signaled smaller interest rate increases due to slowing GDP growth.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
